## Description {#details}

<p>C++ source file with the implementations for the µOS++ doubly linked list link node classes.</p>


<p>The <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/utils-lists-xpack/docs/api/files/src/doubly-list-links-cpp">doubly-list-links.cpp</a></span> source file contains the C++ implementations of the non-inline methods for the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">doubly_list_links_base</span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">static_doubly_list_links</span> classes, providing an efficient and lightweight linked list management system tailored for embedded applications.</p>


<p>The class definitions are in the <a href="/utils-lists-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/utils/lists/doubly-list-links-h">doubly-list-links.h</a> file.</p>
